description: One class per skill folder. portable: works anywhere, so its SKILL.md (outside fenced code) uses no toolkit_terms and names no app from app_names unless depends_on_app gives the reason. toolkit: Toolkit's own skill, which runs Toolkit itself; it ships in the plugin but is not listed as copyable. The README lists each class in its own table. The baseline holds hits that were already on main; it only shrinks, and each count must match the current hits exactly. Checked by repo/scripts/audit-skill-portability.cjs.

agent-cost-control.reason: Picks a model tier and effort for any automation or helper agent; useful in any project.

codex-ssh-hostinger-coolify-setup-mainta.reason: Runs and maintains a Hostinger VPS with Coolify over SSH.

depends_on_app.Codex: Its steps are written for a Codex session that holds the SSH connection to the server.

controller-bootstrap.reason: Re-enters an assigned Toolkit controller; it only works with Toolkit's controller rules.

external-operation-preflight.reason: Checks a live change on any outside service before it runs.

frontend-art-direction.reason: Gives any frontend a deliberate visual direction.

github-program-reconciler.reason: Keeps Toolkit programme pages and records in step; it depends on Toolkit governance.

local-ai-safety.reason: Reviews any local AI runtime or model setup.

managed-app-foundation-review.reason: Compares managed services before building foundations in any project.

n8n-safety-router.reason: Safety rules for any n8n work.

n8n-workflow-transport.reason: Prepares n8n workflow files offline in any project.

release-readiness-audit.reason: Runs a guarded release-readiness audit on any repository.

repository-agent-rules.reason: Installs and repairs Toolkit's own files in a repository.

secure-ci-cd.reason: Plans security-first CI/CD for any repository.

skill-product-review.reason: Reviews any third-party agent skill before use.

toolkit-env.reason: Manages keys through Toolkit's own credential commands.

toolkit-playbooks.reason: Routes to Toolkit's own working playbooks.

toolkit-setup.reason: Sets up, updates and removes Toolkit itself.

windows-local-dev-services.reason: Runs local dev servers on any Windows computer; Windows is a platform, not an app.
